facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Research support; no standard startup equity stated
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 有明确创业团队/项目，能说明产品、市场和团队
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 MIT / SF venture network 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.International Founder: 可能接受国际 founder；需确认签证/现场要求
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: AI / AI-native；阶段以 Academic researcher / pre-company 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品
facts_raw.Notes: Only five researchers per year; second year includes direct support translating frontier research into products.

facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Research support; no standard startup equity stated
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: An identifiable team or project with a clear explanation of its product, market and founders
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.On-site / Attendance: No standard attendance requirement published. Confirm the current cohort arrangements for MIT / SF venture network.
facts.International Founder: International founders may be eligible; confirm visa and attendance requirements.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: AI / AI-native; primarily at the Academic researcher / pre-company stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Traditional offline businesses without a scalable technology product
facts.Notes: Only five researchers per year; second year includes direct support translating frontier research into products.
